trial_court: Family Court, Hamirpur, H.P. (HMA Petition No. RBT 311/15/2019)
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Petitioner filed a petition under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act seeking restitution of conjugal rights after her husband turned her out of their matrimonial house without reasonable cause.

legal_principles.principle: A party seeking restitution of conjugal rights must establish that the other party has refused to reside with them without a reasonable cause.
legal_principles.held: The petitioner's refusal to reside with the respondent and her subsequent separation from his parents without any reason, establishes that she is not entitled to a decree of restitution of conjugal rights.

legal_principles.principle: A party's conduct can be considered in determining the maintainability of a petition.
legal_principles.held: The petitioner's failure to improve her behavior despite apologies and promises, and her subsequent filing of complaints against the respondent under the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, demonstrates that she has not changed her behavior and the petition is not maintainable.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005

outcome.final_order: The instant appeal is allowed and the order dated 27.10.2020 passed by the learned Court below is set aside.

keywords: Protection of Women from DV Act
